portInfo.description: TasPorts operates Hobart’s commercial harbour including Macquarie Wharf berths (Nos. 1–6) and Princes Wharf berths, with a Cruise section for visiting Tasmania by cruise and berthing facilities information. Project QuayLink / Macquarie Wharf is listed among major projects reshaping the waterfront cruise precinct. Exact LOA/depth for the cruise-preferred berth was not isolated from the cruise overview HTML captured.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Hobart Macquarie Wharf cruise berths — Macquarie Wharf, Hobart, Tasmania
gettingThere.walkingTime: 10-15 minutes to Salamanca Place and CBD—confirm on your sailing programme before you rely on a fixed walk time.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Antarctic wind can be sharp — layers even in summer.
